mapper.insert: insert into CHB_PRD_FEE_POSITION (CDATE, PROD_ID, CCY, FEE_TYPE, FEE_SECTYPE, AMT, ORG_CODE,DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME) values( #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{feeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{feeSectype,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{amt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now() )
mapper.select:
select ifnull(info.FPROD_ID,info.PROD_ID) prodId, info.fprod_id fprodid, info.prod_name prodName, info.fee_id feeId, info.fee_name feeName, info.ccy, ifnull(info.amt,0) amt, info.pay_date payDate, info.org_code orgCode, info.dept_code deptCode, info.remark, info.status, info.data_source dataSource, info.rev_date revDate, info.FEE_TYPE feeType, info.FEE_SECTYPE feeSectype from chb_prd_fee_deal info where info.status != 'D' and pay_date=#{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE}
ifnull(info.FPROD_ID,info.PROD_ID) = #{prodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR}
